label: Dev.to
terms_note: Cross-posts must set canonical_url; links are nofollow; DEV Code of Conduct forbids promotional spam. ~30 reads / 10 writes per 30 s.

auth: 1. The member generates an API key at dev.to › Settings › Extensions › DEV Community API Keys (BYO per tenant).

endpoints.call: POST /articles` {article{title, body_markdown, published, series, main_image, canonical_url, description, tags[≤ 4], organization_id}}

endpoints.purpose: no create-comment endpoint in v1 — replies are human

reference.limits: - ≈ 30 requests / 30 s for reads, 10 / 30 s for writes (429 on excess). - Free. DEV Code of Conduct + terms: canonical_url for cross-posts, no spam; links in posts are nofollow; moderators can unpublish.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: DEV Community API key (dev.to > Settings > Extensions > DEV Community API Keys); sent as the `api-key` header.

me.note: GET /api/users/me returns the authenticated user (MyUser: id, username, name, ...).

read_comments.note: Threaded: each top-level comment carries its replies nested inline (in `raw`); `page` filters top-level comments only. The v1 schema documents only type_of, id_code, created_at, image_url, so author/text are not mapped.

analytics_post.note: Public reaction counts from the article record (ArticleIndex); the runtime cannot compose a nested `metrics` object, so counts are top-level fields.

not_offered.publish_text: POST /api/articles takes a nested {article: {title, body_markdown, published, ...}} body and a mandatory title the vocabulary has no argument for; the runtime's body form is flat (arg name -> top-level key).
not_offered.publish_image: Articles are markdown documents; images are `main_image`/inline markdown inside the same nested {article} body (see publish_text).
not_offered.reply_comment: Forem API v1 has no create-comment endpoint; replies are written by humans on dev.to.
not_offered.read_mentions: No mentions or notifications endpoint in Forem API v1.
not_offered.delete: No delete endpoint in Forem API v1; PUT /api/articles/{id} can only unpublish.

evidence: host dev.to: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (GlobalSign nv-sa)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forem/forem/main/swagger/v1/api_v1.json: 3/3 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
live read without credentials: analytics_post, read_comments returned data that validates against the vocabulary
